no_hit.because: a search whose words the guide uses answers at least one section

hit_limit.because: a search answers at most five sections (guide_search.SEARCH_HIT_LIMIT)

guide_reply_budget.because: every guide reply is at most 8 000 wire bytes, under VS Code's 8 192-byte spill to a file (guide_search.GUIDE_REPLY_BUDGET_WIRE_BYTES)

arguments.search: check the model before a build

expectations.because: every hit carries the ready request that opens it
a rule id is looked up exactly: its first hit is the section of the rules page that holds the rule's row
the ready request names the part that holds the row, so a rule deep in a long section is read in one call
